description: Administrators only: the landing site's week — visits, where they came from, clicks on sign-up, and the registrations that followed. The same numbers the weekly report carries into the monitoring chat. Ask for an earlier week with weeksAgo. The rendered message is not returned, only the figures.

weeksAgo.description: 0 is the last full week, 1 the one before it.
